title: Temporary installations.
officialText:
In addition to the requirements of Section 3102 of this code, temporary installations of air-
supported structures, air-inflated structures, membrane-covered cable structures, membrane-covered frame structures and tents,
collectively known as membrane structures shall comply with the requirements of Article 111 of Chapter 1 of Title 28 of the
Administrative Code.
